name: io.github.khavel/futpicks
title: FutPicks
description: Football data for agents: probable lineups with per-player start probability and expected fantasy points, match analysis, model picks and a public track record for LaLiga, Premier League, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 and Primeira Liga.

environmentVariables.name: FUTPICKS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://futpicks.com.

environmentVariables.name: FUTPICKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Data-scope API key (flab_live_...). Optional: the public tools — probable lineups, matches, picks, track record — work without it.

environmentVariables.name: FUTPICKS_OPS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Ops-scope API key (flab_ops_...), admin only. Optional.
